title: lagochilus hispidus
intro: Lagochilus hispidus, commonly known as Mongolian wolf's bane, is a plant species used in traditional medicine, primarily found in the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Lagochilus hispidus include its ability to relax the smooth muscle, exhibit sedative properties, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
